newsitem.title: GREECE: Inform Lykos says Jan-Sept profit down.
newsitem.headline: Inform Lykos says Jan-Sept profit down.

text.p: High-tech printer Inform Lykos said its first nine-month period profits fell 7.0 percent to 778 million drachmas but sales in value terms were up 6.0 percent in the same period.
"Despite the marked fall in the price of paper up until August, the company's sales rose in value terms by 6.0 percent to 4.103 billion drachmas," it said.
Inform Lykos expected a pick up in the final quarter, seasonally more active, would boost year fiscal year results.
It said it had no long term liabilities with cash and reserves at 1.3 billion drachmas. Its liquidity ratio improved to 5.6 to 1.

The company had funnelled 600 million drachmas in investments during the first nine months of the year aiming to complete a new 4,000 square metre building. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
